name: Nottingham City Land and Planning Policies Development Plan Document (Local Plan Part 2)

housing-numbers.notes: Total provision as modified is 19,748 homes (2,598 above minimum requirement). Broad locations include Waterside (1,076), Boots Campus (230), and Stanton Tip (350). Strategic locations delivery extends beyond plan period. Committed housing is 'other sites deliverable by 2028' from SHLAA. Past completions 2011-2018: 6,020 homes.
